5hGMtgEZODMntPSadcUJbO.title: 沃尔夫谈拉斯维加斯排位赛：尾流改变了最后一圈
5hGMtgEZODMntPSadcUJbO.summary: 拉斯维加斯的长直道放大了尾流的作用。梅赛德斯原本认为拉塞尔有望争夺杆位，最终拿下排位赛最快圈的是队友安东内利。
body: 第三节排位赛的最后一轮，车手既要留出空间给轮胎做准备，也要赶在方格旗前开始计时圈。车流在最后一段聚集，使几名车手没能按原计划跑完最后一轮。
安东内利因五位发车处罚退到第六位，原本排位第二的维斯塔潘继承杆位。排位成绩和正赛发车位需要分别查看。
bodyEn: The field bunched up before the final Q3 runs. Drivers had to balance leaving space to prepare their tyres with crossing the line before the chequered flag, and several could not execute the run as planned.
Antonelli drops to sixth on the grid with a five-place penalty. Verstappen qualified second and inherits pole.
5hGMtgEZODMntPSadcUJbO.summaryEn: The long Vegas straights amplified the tow in qualifying. Mercedes expected George Russell to be in contention for pole, while team-mate Kimi Antonelli ended up fastest.

4k41CN1CbogRoqk1kkOb9C.title: 拉斯维加斯正赛策略：轮胎与进站窗口
4k41CN1CbogRoqk1kkOb9C.summary: 软胎升温快，倍耐力估计软胎换中性胎的一停最快，参考进站窗口是第 22 至 28 圈。
body: 三练是赛前唯一的干地练习。梅赛德斯在长直道上占优，红牛和迈凯伦则在多弯的中段找回时间。发车后的跟车和超车会影响各队什么时候能发挥自己的速度。
夜间低温下，新胎驶出维修区后需要时间升温，提前进站的优势可能缩小。安全车出动、制动抱死或轮胎受损也可能让车队重新选择进站时机。
bodyEn: FP3 provided the weekend’s only dry practice. Mercedes had the edge on the straights, while Red Bull and McLaren recovered time through the tighter middle sector. Traffic and overtaking will determine when each team can use that pace.
In the cool night conditions, fresh tyres can take longer to warm up after a stop, weakening a conventional undercut. A Safety Car, lock-up or tyre damage could change the stop windows.
4k41CN1CbogRoqk1kkOb9C.summaryEn: Pirelli expects a one-stop strategy from softs to mediums to be quickest, with an estimated pit window from Lap 22 to Lap 28.

3k1glJW46dgLm2gZkIsSYo.title: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛正赛看点
3k1glJW46dgLm2gZkIsSYo.summary: 维斯塔潘从杆位发车。安东内利排位最快，五位处罚让他从发车区第三排起步。
body: 梅赛德斯在直道上的表现值得关注。排位时尾流帮助部分车手弥补了直道速度差，正赛里，车手需要决定何时跟车，何时在重刹区尝试进攻。
车手在夜间低温下需要管理轮胎温度。倍耐力预计软胎和中性胎是主要选择，安全车或虚拟安全车会改变一停的最佳时机。
bodyEn: Watch Mercedes’ straight-line speed. The tow helped some cars offset their deficit in qualifying, and drivers will need to decide when to follow and when to attack under heavy braking.
Drivers will have to manage tyre temperatures in the night race. Pirelli favours the soft and medium compounds, with any Safety Car or Virtual Safety Car likely to affect the best one-stop window.
3k1glJW46dgLm2gZkIsSYo.summaryEn: Max Verstappen starts on pole in Las Vegas. Kimi Antonelli was fastest in qualifying, but his five-place penalty drops him to the third row.

1TQF9i21VuFhEkETB6CqPc.title: 林德布拉德谈拉斯维加斯排位，将从第五位发车
1TQF9i21VuFhEkETB6CqPc.summary: 林德布拉德排位列第六，在前方车手的发车处罚生效后升到第五位。
body: Racing Bulls 两辆赛车同时进入 Q3。林德布拉德交出 1 分 34 秒 668，队友劳森列第八。车队在 Q3 保留了一套新软胎用于正赛。
林德布拉德表示，赛前练习圈数偏少，他在排位中逐圈建立信心。在这条长直道很多的赛道上，最后计时圈的车流和尾流也影响了两辆赛车的成绩。
bodyEn: Both Racing Bulls cars reached Q3. Lindblad posted a 1m 34.668s, and team-mate Liam Lawson qualified eighth. The team saved a new set of softs for the race.
Lindblad said the limited practice running meant he was still building confidence lap by lap in qualifying. Traffic and the tow also affected both cars on the long Vegas straights.
1TQF9i21VuFhEkETB6CqPc.summaryEn: Arvid Lindblad qualified sixth and will line up fifth after a penalty for a driver ahead of him.

3nVBux5Arj5K1MNogvg9j9.title: 拉斯维加斯排位赛后：各队怎么说
3nVBux5Arj5K1MNogvg9j9.summary: 排位赛后，各队谈到尾流、最后一轮的车流，以及如何在低温下让轮胎尽快进入工作区间。
body: Racing Bulls 两辆赛车均进入 Q3，排位分别列第六和第八。Alpine 同样双车进入 Q3，加斯利和科拉平托最终分列第九和第十。
倍耐力认为目前收集到的数据更支持软胎接中性胎的一停。排位中曾多次出现制动抱死，正赛车手需要留意轮胎擦伤对后半段速度的影响。
bodyEn: Racing Bulls qualified sixth and eighth. Alpine also put both cars into Q3, with Pierre Gasly and Franco Colapinto ninth and tenth.
Pirelli’s running so far favours a soft-to-medium one-stop. Lock-ups were common in qualifying, so drivers will need to manage the risk of flat spots during the race.
3nVBux5Arj5K1MNogvg9j9.summaryEn: After qualifying, the teams discussed the tow, traffic on the final runs and the challenge of warming up tyres in cool conditions.

48hDMDkgL0meTLKg3usEg6.title: 加斯利 Q2 第二，Alpine 在 Q3 未能延续速度
48hDMDkgL0meTLKg3usEg6.summary: 加斯利在拉斯维加斯排位赛第二阶段排到第二，最终和队友科拉平托分列第九、第十。
body: 加斯利认为 Q2 的出场时机、暖胎圈和车流间距都恰到好处。Q3 最后一轮赛车聚在一起，他不得不减速留出空间，抵达一号弯时轮胎温度已经偏低。
科拉平托在 Q2 排第七。他说，Q3 最后一次尝试也被暖胎圈的车流打乱。在长直道上找到合适的尾流，同时给自己留出暖胎空间，是 Alpine 当天遇到的难题。
bodyEn: Gasly was happy with his track position and tyre preparation in Q2. When the field bunched up for the last run in Q3, he slowed to create a gap and arrived at Turn 1 with colder tyres.

Colapinto was seventh in Q2. His final Q3 attempt was also compromised on the preparation lap. The challenge for Alpine was finding a tow on the long straights while still leaving enough room to prepare the tyres.
48hDMDkgL0meTLKg3usEg6.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly was second-fastest in Q2. He and team-mate Franco Colapinto ultimately qualified ninth and tenth.
